description.en: Press a chord to surface letter labels over every visible interactive target in the DSH web GUI, then type a label to click or focus that target; label length is derived per round from the candidate count, and the chord is remappable in settings.
description.zh: 按下组合键后，DSH Web 界面里每个可见的可交互目标都会浮出一个字母标签，敲标签即可点击或聚焦它；标签长度按候选数量每轮推导，组合键可在设置中修改。
